app_info.subtitle: Professional LaTeX Resumes
app_info.description: Create, customize, compile, and email professional, ATS-optimized LaTeX resumes. Connects securely to your ResumeForge account to manage your master resume data, instantly preview beautifully rendered templates, and send copies directly to your inbox.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool is read-only because it simply fetches the stored master resume data from the user's database record without mutating any server state.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool is not open world because it does not communicate with external systems or network targets; it only queries the local ResumeForge database.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is not destructive because it does not perform any update, deletion, or overwrite operations on any user data.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool is not read-only because it updates and overwrites the user's master resume JSON data stored in the database.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool is not open world because it only saves data to the local ResumeForge database and does not connect to external network services.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is not destructive because it does not delete user accounts, reset data, or destroy system state, although it performs updates.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool is not read-only because it runs a compilation task on the server that generates new temporary files (PDFs) on the disk.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool is not open world because all LaTeX compilation and PDF rendering are completed locally on our server without accessing any external APIs or third-party web services.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is not destructive because it generates new preview PDFs and does not overwrite, delete, or modify any user database records.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool is not read-only because it triggers an outgoing operation (sending an email via SMTP) rather than just reading data.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool is open world because it sends an email message to the user's external email address, routing traffic over the public internet to third-party mail servers.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is not destructive because it only transmits an email message and does not delete or overwrite any user records or system data.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool is read-only because it returns a static list of supported resume templates and their metadata.
justifications.open_world_justification: This tool is not open world because it reads template metadata from local static configuration and does not access external network targets.
justifications.destructive_justification: This tool is not destructive because it is a read-only metadata retrieval and does not modify any state or database entries.

test_cases.description: Verify that the assistant can retrieve the list of available LaTeX templates.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the available resume templates.
test_cases.expected_output: Should list templates including 'executive' with their names and descriptions.

test_cases.description: Verify that the assistant can successfully retrieve the authenticated user's master resume.
test_cases.expected_output: Should display the user's name, contact details, work experience, and educational background from the master resume.

test_cases.description: Verify that the assistant can update the master resume with new work experience information.
test_cases.user_prompt: Add a new work experience entry to my resume: Lead Software Engineer at Google from May 2024 to Present.
test_cases.expected_output: Should confirm that the master resume has been updated and saved successfully.

test_cases.description: Verify that the assistant can generate a compiled PDF preview from the master resume data.
test_cases.user_prompt: Compile my resume to a PDF using the executive template.
test_cases.expected_output: Should return a download link for the compiled PDF file.

test_cases.description: Verify that the assistant can send the compiled PDF to the user's registered email address.
test_cases.user_prompt: Send the generated PDF /pdf/job-123/main.pdf to my email.
test_cases.expected_output: Should confirm that the resume has been successfully sent to the user's inbox.

negative_test_cases.description: Verify that retrieving the master resume fails gracefully when the user's session is expired or not authenticated.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Should prompt the user to log in or authorize the app, displaying an authentication error message.

negative_test_cases.description: Verify that saving the master resume fails when the payload has an invalid structure that violates the JSON Schema.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Update my master resume but set the header to null.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Should display validation errors and refuse to overwrite the master resume data.

negative_test_cases.description: Verify that emailing the resume fails when the PDF URL is invalid, empty, or not found on the server.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Should display a descriptive error message indicating that the PDF file was not found or could not be sent.
